title: Failure Reason, Only On Failure
description: A payment that goes through cleanly has nothing to explain — the ledger's failure column should stay blank unless something actually went wrong.
successCondition: Pay an invoice with a well-formed card number that isn't one of the two documented test-decline numbers (any other 13-19 digit number succeeds per docs/api/billing.md). The response's payment.failureReason is null. Querying the payments table via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms failure_reason IS NULL and status = 'succeeded'.
hints: The two special-cased decline/timeout card numbers are documented in docs/api/billing.md — use any other well-formed number to get a succeeded outcome.
select status, failure_reason from payments where id = '<id>'; is enough to check both columns at once.
